read.en: AAOI rose 6.8% on Oct 28 to $82.22, trading between $77.02 and $82.28. It is above the falling 5-day ($73.3) and 10-day ($75.8) averages and below the falling 30-day ($95.8) and 100-day ($116.5) and the rising 200-day ($113.8). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13 and below zero, histogram narrowing toward a cross; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($87.13), and RSI is 44.
read.zh: AAOI 10月28日上涨 6.8%，收于 $82.22，盘中区间 $77.02–82.28。股价位于下行的 5 日（$73.3）和 10 日均线（$75.8）上方，低于下行的 30 日（$95.8）和 100 日均线（$116.5）以及上行的 200 日均线（$113.8）。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄并接近交叉；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$87.13），RSI 为 44。

read.en: The close cleared $77.3 (Oct 27 high) and $80.5–81.3 (Oct 19 and 21 highs), now support. Resistance is $83.4–85.0 (Oct 15–16 highs), then $87.1 (SAR) and $95.8 (30-day). Support is $80.5–81.3, then $75.8–77.3 (10-day, Oct 27 high, Oct 28 low) and $73.3 (5-day). A close above $85 would target $87–96; below $80.5, $76–77.
